reason: All generatable production media is finalized and integrated; release remains blocked by non-humanoid facility animation and missing validation metadata.

optimization.method: weld, constrained meshoptimizer simplification, Draco 16-bit compression

blockers: Mint animation tooling only accepts humanoid-riggable models; no callable Mint capability can animate the generated doors, terminal, ledger, alarm panel, or extraction beacon.
Mint artifact manifests omitted license metadata and required source geometry declarations (units, basis, pivot, bounds, triangle/material/texture counts); local inspection can derive only a subset.
Mint weapon GLBs are single-mesh models with no named optic, muzzle, magazine, grip, stock, or muzzle-flash sockets; runtime attachment anchors are derived rather than source-authored.
The generated first-person-arms artifact is a single full-body skinned operator mesh; runtime bone culling collapses head/neck/legs so only the arm chain remains visible in the production camera.

fallbackPolicy: Visible procedural models, world art, Canvas textures, flat-color VFX sprites, and Web Audio synthesis are disabled. Invisible physics proxies, hitboxes, AI, raycasts, camera motion, HUD layout, and particle simulation remain code-driven.

animation.note: Mint returned Choose a plan to animate models
